How To Not Get Stuck With A House You Hate! 

Here in TX we have what’s called an option period! That good ole option period is your unrestricted right to terminate! No matter what! 

During the crazy times ppl were waiving this period and getting hit with a ton of surprises but now you can negotiate for a longer option and make sure you’re doing all of your due diligence!
